Platform

Repository software

GOREPO is built on a modern open-source stack developed for Godfrey Okoye University. The platform is a full-stack Next.js application with a PostgreSQL database, providing open access to the university's research outputs.

The system is compatible with the OAI-PMH 2.0 protocol and exposes Dublin Core metadata for harvesting by aggregators such as BASE, OpenDOAR, and Google Scholar.

Technical credits: Next.js (Vercel), Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, NextAuth.js, Tailwind CSS. The repository design was inspired by EPrints 3, developed by the University of Southampton.
